feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 12 May 2026 9:52pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Largely cloudy overnight as blustery showers affect the island at times, some of which will be on the heavy side. Fresh to strong west or northwest wind and a minimum temperature of 5°C.

Further showers tomorrow morning and again they may be heavy in places. The showers then becoming isolated in the afternoon as sunny intervals develop. Strong northwest wind and a maximum temperature of 12°C but feeling colder in the wind.


##Outlook##

Cloudy start on Thursday with a few showery outbreaks of rain, the showers becoming isolated into the afternoon as sunny intervals develop. Fresh to strong north or northwest wind with a top temperature again around 12°C.
